chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Sufyan al-Bazufari, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Abdullah ibn Bukair, from Zurarah, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said -and we mentioned Humran ibn A'yun-: 'By Allah, he will definitely never apostatize.' Then he paused for a moment, and then said: 'Yes, by Allah, he will definitely never apostatize.'

key_terms.أَطْرَقَ: he paused or lowered his gaze in thought
key_terms.حُمْرَانَ بْنَ أَعْيَنَ: Humran ibn A'yun, a companion of the Imams
key_terms.يَرْتَدُّ: to apostatize or turn back from faith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about Humran ibn A'yun's faith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) affirms the steadfastness of Humran ibn A'yun, one of the four approved emissaries, declaring he will never apostatize. The Imam’s initial statement followed by a pause and repetition underscores the divine certainty of this guarantee, highlighting Humran’s unique status during the Minor Occultation. This assurance served to bolster the confidence of the Shia community in the reliability of their primary link to the Imam.
